prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A middle-aged man with short curly hair and a mustache stands indoors, holding a smartphone in his right hand and looking slightly to his left with a skeptical, mildly unimpressed expression. He wears a turquoise blue collared shirt over a salmon pink t-shirt, creating a soft, casual color contrast. The background is softly lit with a neutral, pale green wall, giving the scene a calm, everyday atmosphere. Behind him, a round wall clock with black numbers and hands is visible, slightly out of focus, indicating a mundane, real-world setting. To the left, part of a vending machine or payment kiosk is visible, featuring a credit card slot, a keypad, and instructional stickers, adding to the sense of a public or semi-public space. A sign with an arrow and the word "RESTROOMS" is partially visible on the wall, further grounding the scene in a practical, everyday environment. The lighting is even and natural, with a shallow depth of field that keeps the man in sharp focus while gently blurring the background, lending a cinematic, documentary-style realism to the composition. The overall mood is one of quiet observation, capturing a candid moment of modern life.
